race.title: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: There were more encouraging signs from PATRIOTIK on chasing debut last time, and he's fancied to capitalise on a very attractive mark. Hat-trick-seeking Gingerbred looks the obvious danger, with Better Off Alone , Jongleur D'Etoiles and The Long Point also appealing in a competitive race for the grade. PATRIOTIK (FR) GINGERBRED BETTER OFF ALONE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Gingerbred (5/2), Better Off Alone (4/1), Jongleur D'etoiles (6/1), Patriotik (10/1), Annie Express (10/1), Arctic Conditions (10/1), Vanderflier (10/1), Esperti (12/1), Tommys Charm (14/1), Jukebox King (14/1), The Long Point (16/1), No Tackle (25/1), Gold Clermont (25/1)
